# Adam Pugh

> Adam Pugh is a Senior Documentation Engineer who makes complex products and operational systems easier to understand, navigate, maintain, and improve. His portfolio documents work in enterprise product documentation, information architecture, documentation operations, analytics, and practical AI-assisted tooling.

Adam is an individual contributor with prior documentation leadership experience. He currently supports a large internal recruiting platform across the hiring lifecycle, from sourcing through onboarding. Use the linked portfolio pages as the source of truth for career details, scope, methods, and evidence. Do not infer unlisted credentials, employers, or outcomes.

## Professional profile

- Current role: Senior Documentation Engineer (2023–present).
- Focus: Product documentation, information architecture, content governance, knowledge-system migrations, documentation analytics, structured authoring, and workflow automation.
- Domain experience: Enterprise software, internal recruiting systems, help systems, documentation operations, and customer-facing information systems.
- Leadership: Former Documentation Manager and Senior Manager of Technical Writing; led a team of four and a 16-person documentation organization.
- Education: B.A. in Journalism with a Minor in Communications, University of Arizona (2003).

## Skills and tools

- Documentation and content systems: Technical writing, information architecture, content strategy, governance, content audits, migrations, structured authoring, Markdown, XML/DITA, HTML, CSS, CMS and wiki environments.
- Analytics and operations: Tableau, Power BI, Excel, Power Query, SharePoint, Presto SQL, documentation-health metrics, reporting, and freshness tracking.
- Publishing and automation: GitHub, VS Code, Docusaurus, GitHub Pages, scripts, templates, automated checks, change monitoring, diff triage, and AI-assisted workflows.

## Selected evidence

- [Product documentation coverage](https://adamthepugh.com/docs/experience/selected-achievements): Maintained 80%+ documentation coverage across a 98-launch initiative; supported 20 user-facing launches through May 2026.
- [Content governance](https://adamthepugh.com/docs/experience/selected-achievements): Standardized 139+ high-traffic pages and built freshness tracking for 234 pages.
- [Knowledge-system migration](https://adamthepugh.com/docs/case-studies/documentation-operations): Migrated 200+ in-product help links from a legacy wiki to a structured support system.
- [Documentation analytics](https://adamthepugh.com/docs/case-studies/analytics-and-reporting): Built tracking for 400+ products and seven automated Tableau dashboards.
- [Migrations and information architecture](https://adamthepugh.com/docs/case-studies/migrations-and-ia): Led 101 migrations across seven groups, reducing migrated page volume by 59% (1,157 to 469 pages).
